claim_class: C2 state-measurement against named public published labels
model: unchanged D2 ResNet18UNet with official ImageNet ResNet18 weights

target.operation: skeletonize published mask on native grid; Euclidean distance expressed at 512-px short side

checkpoint_rule: maximum CRACK500 validation mean binary centreline-field Dice at threshold 0.5 only

evaluation.normalization: resize probability bilinear and published mask nearest-neighbour to 512-px short side, then skeletonize thresholded prediction and reference
evaluation.primary_baseline: D1 scratch U-Net, prospectively selected because D3 had higher 2-px tolerant F1 on both sources

decision_rule.validation_ceiling: selected checkpoint CRACK500 validation mean centreline F1 at 4 px
decision_rule.absolute_f1_floor: max(0.50, 0.60 * validation_ceiling) applied to each development source mean F1 at 4 px
decision_rule.paired_improvement_metric: candidate minus D1 mean centreline F1 at 2 px
decision_rule.advance: both CFD and GAPS384 meet every absolute and paired condition
decision_rule.stop: either source misses any necessary condition; stop public-mask architecture/UQ expansion

mechanical_rechecks.receipt_required: remote on-disk child and watchdog JSON; SSH exit code alone is insufficient
